description: List your Tracker entries (the /tracker board: saved, contacted, applied, screen, assessment, interview, final, offer, accepted, declined, rejected, withdrawn). Filter by stage, company or role text, or a Trackly job ID. Returns each entry's id, jobPostingId, company, role, currentStage, stageEnteredAt, version and link. Pass applicationId alone to get that entry with its events. Use it to find the applicationId for trackly_update_tracker_stage, trackly_add_tracker_note or trackly_retract_tracker_event. Contact email addresses are never returned.

applicationId.description: One Tracker entry ID. Returns that entry with its events (ids, kinds, stages, dates and note text), so you can name an event for trackly_retract_tracker_event. Cannot be combined with the other filters.

context.description: Briefly explain why this tool helps the current job-search goal. Never include resume text, profile answers, demographic or work-authorization answers, application notes, credentials, or secrets.

jobId.description: Trackly job posting ID; returns only the Tracker entries linked to that job

query.description: Company or role text to match, up to 100 characters

stage.description: Only entries currently in this stage. One of: contacted, saved, applied, screen, assessment, interview, final, offer, accepted, declined, rejected, withdrawn

name: trackly_list_tracker_applications
